boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer casing exchanging heat with the environment by convection and radiation

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner tube wall swept by district-heating water

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

objective.name: J
objective.description: Objective functional; minimizing it maximizes the heat rejected to the environment through the outer casing

state_equation.description: Non-linear steady heat conduction with convection and radiation boundary conditions
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} h_H u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} \varepsilon \sigma u^{4} \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_i} h_H u_{H} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} \varepsilon \sigma u_{amb}^{4} \delta u \,ds_x

adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} h_H \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} 4 \varepsilon \sigma u^{3} \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x

boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer casing exchanging heat with the environment by convection and radiation
boundaries.rationale: Label assigned by geometric reasoning: outer casing corresponds to mesh label 3.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner tube wall swept by district-heating water
boundaries.rationale: Label assigned by geometric reasoning: inner tube wall corresponds to mesh label 2.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: No Dirichlet boundaries in this problem; all boundaries are Robin.

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

optimization_config.rationale: Parameters chosen based on typical level set shape optimization settings for a pipe cross-section of size ~1.0 m. hmin/hmax set to 1% and 10% of domain size. Diffusion 1e-4 for regularization. v0 1e-3 for initial step. 30 iterations. Level set initialized as the signed distance to the initial inner radius r0=0.1. Design boundary is Gamma_i (label 2), fixed boundary is Gamma_o (label 3).
